data.name: Synced Warriors
data.detailed_description:
Description


Synced Warriors is a puzzle game where each button press controls all of the characters on the screen at the same time. The main feature of the game is that each character moves relative to the direction they are facing. This means that if you instruct the characters to move left, they do not move to the left relative to the camera. Instead, they move left relative to the direction they are facing. This makes for some interesting puzzle situations as you attempt to orchestrate a battle between the forces of red, blue, green, and yellow.

Modes


In puzzle mode you attempt to move the warriors to the puzzle pads of the same color while killing off the extra warriors.

In infinite mode you attempt to keep the number of warriors on the map greater than 0 and less than a specified number.

Features


  • Dozens of puzzles
  • Three kinds of warriors that add complexity to the puzzles
  • Moving blocks and ballistae
  • Puzzle editor for making and sharing puzzles

reviews.review:
A clever puzzle game that gets progressively more challenging as you clear levels. I'm currently playing Puzzle Mode, in which you have one or more warriors who have to move across an obstacle-laden map, with a goal of reaching their same-colored square in an optimal number of moves. Every warrior on the map turns / moves the same way when you press a key, which forces you to think spatially to get them all to their allotted spaces without wasting moves or getting stuck and having to re-start the level, and it can be pretty mind-bending when there are multiple warriors on the map. Finishing a level unlocks the next no matter how many moves it takes you (good for the impatient), but I found it more fun to replay levels until I completed them in the minimal number of moves.

It's casual yet challenging, and can be played even if you only have a couple of free minutes. Fairly priced at $1.99.
